svg.aria-label: Seven stacked layers of defence: LZB, the lateral signals, the control-centre authorisation, the block-clear check, the control-room cross-check, ASFA and driving on sight. A dashed line passes down through holes in the layers reported to have failed to a collision at kilometre 118; the cross-check is marked amber and ASFA unknown
svg.text: An accident trajectory, top to bottom
holes marked only where officials or reporting support them
out of service after the computer fault
red at Urda; overridden by the order
warnings came in; AVE not stopped
